literal_meaning: মুখখানি যেন মাটির বড় হাঁড়ির মতো
figurative_meaning_en: Having a broad or wide face
similar_in_english: Having a face as round as a full moon
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মুখখানি যেন তোলহাঁড়ি, খুব চওড়া দেখায়।
বাচ্চাটির মুখখানি যেন তোলহাঁড়ি, হাসলে আরও বড় হয়ে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: His face is like a large pot, very broad-looking.
The child's face is like a large pot; it looks even bigger when he smiles.
history: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali rural life where large earthen pots (তোলহাঁড়ি) were common household items for cooking and storage, used to vividly describe facial features.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of everyday rural pottery, emphasizing broad facial structure in a humorous or descriptive way.
